data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne, having raised €100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 11 peers—three public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and eight private entities including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

A stage-progression methodology was applied, using the €100M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement. This yields an implied valuation of €190M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while six same-sector peers exist, none met the minimum threshold of three comparable datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacent-stage timing, or valuation tier, making a narrow-set median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €162M (low) to €218M (high), with a median point of €190M. This range reflects single-method triangulation and carries material uncertainty around the peer-comparable approach. Key unknowns include the company's capital efficiency relative to the fragmented quantum hardware landscape, time-to-revenue trajectory, and whether the private peer set (heavily weighted toward hardware-focused competitors) represents appropriate comparables for Alice & Bob's specific technology position. Additional operational metrics and explicit revenue or customer data would materially improve precision.
